dog.description_text: Bumble is an 8 week old female Great Dane/Lab mix with the sweetest, gentlest demeanor, plenty of hearts to steal, and some big paws to grow into! According to information provided by the shelter, her mom was a purebred Great Dane. Since arriving from our shelter partner, Bumble has been loving life in her foster home and settling in beautifully. She has started her puppy vaccines and is learning the ropes as we get to know more about her personality. This sweet girl can’t wait to find a forever family to learn, grow, and share a lifetime of love with!
dog.name: Bumble
